notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first Eloise trigger, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Resolve the second Eloise trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
